q: Twelve of the animals are still ___.
explanation: '풀려나 잡히지 않은'이라는 뜻의 관용 표현은 on the loose이다. 원문: "Twelve of the animals are still on the loose."
'추후 안내가 있을 때까지'라는 뜻의 전치사구는 until further notice이며, farther는 물리적 거리에 쓰이므로 further와 혼동하면 안 된다. 원문: "Citizens should stay indoors until further notice."

q: Not a single act or incident ___ has taken place.
explanation: act or incident가 '위에 서술된' 수동의 의미이므로 과거분사 described가 명사를 뒤에서 수식한다. 원문: "Not a single act or incident described above has taken place."

q: At that time, those ___ read the article carefully laughed out loud.
explanation: 선행사 those(사람들)를 수식하며 관계사절에서 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 알맞다. 원문: "At that time, those who read the article carefully laughed out loud."

q: Those who didn't read it ___ got really worried.
explanation: '끝까지'라는 뜻의 전치사구는 to the end이며, in the end('결국')와 의미가 다르므로 혼동하지 않아야 한다. 원문: "Those who didn't read it to the end got really worried."

options: Not knowing the news was false
Not known the news was false
Not to know the news was false
Don't know the news was false
explanation: 이유를 나타내는 분사구문(= Because many people didn't know the news was false)으로 부정형은 분사 앞에 not을 붙인 Not knowing이 된다. 원문: "Not knowing the news was false, many people panicked."

q: Some tried to escape the city while others went into the parks with guns ___ the animals.
explanation: '~하기 위해서'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사의 부사적 용법이다. 원문: "Some tried to escape the city while others went into the parks with guns to hunt the animals."

q: So why did The Herald ___ such news?
explanation: 조동사 did가 쓰인 의문문에서는 본동사가 항상 동사원형이 되어야 하므로 make up이 온다. 원문: "So why did The Herald make up such news?"

q: Later, they confessed that they ___ so that they could draw the readers' attention to the unsafe conditions at the zoo.
explanation: 이어동사(make up)의 목적어가 대명사(it)일 경우 반드시 '동사+대명사+부사' 순서로 써야 하므로 made it up이 맞다. 원문: "Later, they confessed that they made it up so that they could draw the readers' attention to the unsafe conditions at the zoo."

q: Mejk Swenekafew, a Slav worker at the Columbia Coal Mine, ___ by John Pecitello near the mining camp Thursday evening.
explanation: 주어 Mejk Swenekafew가 총에 맞고 부상을 입은 대상이므로 수동태(be+p.p.)가 쓰이며, be shot과 be wounded가 병렬 구조를 이룬다. 원문: "Mejk Swenekafew, a Slav worker at the Columbia Coal Mine, was shot and seriously wounded by John Pecitello near the mining camp Thursday evening."
